item.title: New flu variant 'super' K linked to spike in cases amid holiday gatherings
item.description: This flu season seems to be getting worse by the day, according to health officials. The bulk of this year's cases are being linked to a new variant known as subclade K.

item.title: Authorities seize $40M worth of motorcycles tied to ex-Olympian turned alleged drug kingpin
item.description: Mexican authorities have seized numerous motorcycles believed to be owned by a fugitive on the FBI's 10 Most Wanted list -- Ryan Wedding, an alleged drug kingpin and former Canadian Olympic snowboarder.

item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Cold Weather Advisory issued for inland valleys, hills overnight
item.description: We can expect another cold morning tomorrow, as overnight temperatures will drop as low 33 degrees in the coldest inland communities. A Cold Weather Advisory will be in effect from 1 a.m. to 9 a.m. for the North Bay inland valleys and mountains and the East Bay hills and East Bay inland valleys.

item.title: SF to develop 15-story affordable housing building for LGBTQ+ seniors as aging population grows
item.description: San Francisco is an aging city. By 2030, nearly one-third of the city will be populated by people 60 and older. That's more than the state average. "As folks age, incomes become restricted, the cost of living rises and so the need for affordable housing becomes even greater."

item.title: Special run-off election: Voters to decide on Santa Clara County assessor ahead of new year
item.description: Two candidates are vying to become Santa Clara County's new assessor as the Registrar of Voters will be counting ballots in the new year.

item.title: Cleanup continues on San Mateo County coast days after storms
item.description: The cleanup continues on the San Mateo County coast Monday, days after storms hit the region. Many residents lost power for four days -- and some report still not having cellphone reception.

item.title: Frustrated SF Sunset District residents, merchants demand more PG&E credits for power outages
item.description: San Francisco Sunset District residents and business owners are protesting after multiple rounds of power outages. Their demands center around the bill credits PG&E is promising and the claim forms to get them.

item.title: Video shows car almost falling down cliff near Lake Tahoe on Christmas
item.description: New dashcam video shows the moment good Samaritans jumped into action to help two people whose car came close to falling down a cliff near Lake Tahoe on Christmas.

item.title: Texas teen missing since Christmas Eve believed to be in 'imminent danger': Sheriff
item.description: A Texas teen who has been missing since Christmas Eve was last seen leaving her home that morning and is believed to be in "imminent danger," law enforcement officials said on Sunday.

item.title: A Nickel an Oyster: How San Francisco's iconic Waterbar restaurant is giving back to the city
item.description: For nearly two decades, Waterbar has been a steady presence on San Francisco's waterfront, offering diners a front-row seat to the Bay Bridge, the tides of the Embarcadero, and a dining experience rooted in the city it calls home. Here's how its relationship with the environment is extending into philanthropy.
